We have mass spec data: main peak at m/z 193.1103 (intensity 100). Likely molecular ion. Need to deduce formula. Use isotopic pattern: small M+1 at 194.1135 (12.5% relative). That suggests presence of ~1 carbon (13C) natural abundance 1.1% per carbon, so 12.5% corresponds to about 11-12 carbons? Actually 13C abundance 1.1% per carbon, so M+1 intensity ~ (number of C)*1.1% relative to M. So 12.5% => ~11-12 carbons. Could be 12 carbons gives 13.2% close. So maybe C12.

Check M+2 at 195.1159 intensity 1.13% maybe due to 2 13C or presence of heteroatoms like S, Cl, Br. But low.

Thus formula maybe C12H? Need DBE.

We need more data: maybe NMR etc. Let's get 1H NMR.
